issues.title: Integration-branch dependency not tracked as formal LBA
issues.details: The plan depends on integration/r001-archon-piv-loop-codex-v2 existing with S1-S5 V2 workflow surfaces. This is described in Plan Status, Constraints, and P0-T1 commands, but the Unresolved Items > Blockers section is empty and no [LBA] entry exists. Per the plan's own rules, LBA items are always blocking until checked.
issues.suggested_fix: Add an [LBA] entry under Unresolved Items > Blockers stating that the integration branch must exist with the S1-S5 V2 workflow surfaces before P1 starts. P0-T1 already verifies this, so the LBA can be resolved during P0 execution.
